# Let Me Instinct That For You

> Hebrew web tool. You write a question, get a share link. Whoever opens the link sees the message typed out in a WhatsApp-style chat, then WhatsApp opens with Instinct (the AI assistant) and the message prefilled. The sender presses send themselves; nothing is sent automatically.

- Inspired by "Let Me Google That For You".
- The link generator is free and needs no signup or install. Using Instinct itself is governed separately by Instinct. Works on phone and desktop browsers.
- Home: https://let-me-instinct.pages.dev/
- Link format: https://let-me-instinct.pages.dev/?q=<url-encoded message>
